changed: Device Sync now sends a large library of this device's own records in batches, so the first sync of a well-stocked device takes far fewer tries instead of carrying on minute by minute. Against a self-hosted sync server that hasn't been updated yet, Device Sync carries on sending one record at a time, as before.

added: `blob_batch_frames.dart`: `SyncBlobBatchFrameReader.upload` reads the body of a `PUT /v1/blobs/batch` (blob frames only, no hash twice, at most `syncBlobBatchMaxUploadBlobs`), and `SyncBlobBatchFormatException.exceedsCap` marks a body that broke a cap rather than the format.
